summary: TNL Mediagene, a Taiwan-based foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K reporting completion of a $6.25 million private placement of newly authorized Series A and B convertible preferred shares to Vector Advisory Partners LLC. The October 30, 2026 closing followed an October 19 securities purchase agreement, with $1.5 million paid at signing and $4.75 million at closing, partly via direct payoffs of convertible notes. Preferred shares carry $1.66449 original issue price, 1.0x non-participating liquidation preference, no maturity or put; Series A represents 19.99% as-converted pre-approval, and both series would total roughly 80% post-approval, implying a change of control contingent on shareholder, Nasdaq and Cayman approvals.
